To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
stress causes a reduction in mobility, and that mobility reduction is responsible for the apparent reduction in series resistance.

(1) Mobility model plays an important role in extraction of source drain series resistance, (2) The series resistance of a device decreases with stress time, (3) The mobility degradation of the channel is a function of stress time, (4) The mobility degradation is not uniform along the channel, (5) A new threshold voltage degradation model is proposed that separates the effects of damaged portion of the channel from that of undamaged portion of the channel.
the series resistance of a MOSFET can be extracted using the threshold voltage shift of a MOSFETS with different channel lengths.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a new methodology for extracting stress dependent source-drains series resistance for short channel devices, and the development of a model for the time dependent degradation of the threshold voltage.
the extraction of the source–drain resistance and mobility degradation under various stress conditions, for channel lengths below the 0.5 µm regime.
a new methodology to study the stress dependent source–drain resistance and mobility degradation in submicron MOSFETs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the stress dependent source–drain resistance extraction method should be used with caution, and that the extracted values should be treated with caution.
stress induced degradation of the mobility is the primary cause of the reduction in series resistance.
the series resistance is not reduced after stress.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the series resistance of short-channel devices can only be extracted by using a mobility model which is modified to take into account the stress induced changes.
the mobility degradation model is the key to understanding the series resistance behaviour under stress.
the mobility degradation model is a key to understanding and predicting the stress dependent source-drained series resistance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
mobility degradation must be considered while extracting stress induced series resistance for short channel devices.
a stress induced change in the mobility model is the key to understanding the stress dependent series resistance.
